levels.description: Gain Low Profile: when a non-summoned ally lives, enemies reduce their targeting priority toward you by 10.

effects.name: Low Profile
effects.description: With another living non-summoned ally, enemies are less likely to target you (−10 AI target priority).

levels.description: Unlock Vanish: once per combat, gain 30% Evasion and further lower enemy targeting priority by 30 for two personal turns.

effects.name: Vanish
effects.description: Once per combat, gain 30% Evasion and reduce your AI target priority by 30 for two personal turns. No AP cost.
